prompt: Why is the plan to play a recording important when choosing the review room?
promptZh: 選檢視教室時，為什麼只播放錄影這一點很重要？

options.text: The review qualifies for Room H because participants will not control the panel.
options.zh: 參與者不會操作面板，所以檢視可用 H 室。
options.whyZh: 螢幕上雖會出現控制面板，但沒人能送出指令；預約時可按紙本練習處理。

options.text: The review must use Room E because a panel appears in the recording.
options.zh: 錄影中有面板，所以檢視必須用 E 室。
options.whyZh: 是否看得見面板不是關鍵；能否實際送指令才是。

options.text: The recording allows Ira’s live check to be completed during the review.
options.zh: 播放錄影就能在檢視時完成艾拉的實機檢查。
options.whyZh: 艾拉仍須親自輪到操作；觀看錄影不算。

options.text: The recording means the checklist can be omitted.
options.zh: 播放錄影就可以不看檢查表。
options.whyZh: 檢視的目的就是確認檢查表用詞；錄影不是取代檢查表。

explanationZh: 螢幕上雖會出現控制面板，但沒人能送出指令；預約時可按紙本練習處理。
evidence: An on-screen view of a control panel is a paper exercise for booking purposes if nobody can send commands. / The review will show a recording of the panel on screen. It will not let anyone send a command.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: An on-screen view of a control panel is a paper exercise for booking purposes if nobody can send commands.
The review will show a recording of the panel on screen. It will not let anyone send a command.

vocabulary.note: 表示某項安排在預約時如何歸類。
